tools.name: compare_unify_to_competitor
tools.description: Open a side-by-side comparison page between Unify and a named competitor. Use when the user asks 'Unify vs X', 'how does Unify compare to X', or wants alternatives evaluation.

competitor.description: Competitor identifier. Must be one of the listed values.

tools.name: request_unify_demo
tools.description: Open Unify's get-started page to request a demo or talk to sales. Use when the user wants to see Unify in action, talk to a human, or evaluate Unify for their team.

tools.name: start_unify_trial
tools.description: Start a self-serve free trial of Unify. Use when the user wants to try Unify without booking a demo.

tools.name: view_customer_stories
tools.description: Open Unify's customer stories page. Use when the user asks for case studies, customer examples, social proof, or who uses Unify. Notable customers include Perplexity, Justworks, Anrok, Together AI, Navattic, and Spellbook.

tools.name: view_pricing
tools.description: Open Unify's pricing page. Use when the user asks how much Unify costs, what plans are available, or wants to compare tiers.

tools.name: view_recent_product_updates
tools.description: Open Unify's changelog showing recent product releases and updates. Use when the user asks what's new, what shipped recently, or about specific feature releases.

tools.name: view_signal_type
tools.description: Open a Unify signals page describing a specific intent signal source. Use when the user asks about a specific signal type like website intent, champion tracking, new hires, or product usage.

signal.description: Signal type. Must be one of the listed values.

tools.name: view_solution_by_role
tools.description: Open the Unify solution page tailored to a specific go-to-market role or motion. Use when the user identifies as a sales/marketing/RevOps/growth leader or asks how Unify fits a specific GTM motion.

role.description: Role or GTM motion. Must be one of the listed values.
